title: Window pegs: Proof strip
summary: For every contiguous window of exactly k readings, produce its maximum from left to right. Produce no values if k exceeds the number of readings. Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.
descriptionMd:
The inspection frame keeps only pegs that could still be the tallest in its current window. Alma rolls a fresh proof strip into the office typewriter. The supervisor wants the readings in their precise working order before signing the file.

For every contiguous window of exactly k readings, produce its maximum from left to right. Produce no values if k exceeds the number of readings.

Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order.

Implement windowPegsProofStrip(readings, k). Use k exactly where specified above.
unitIntro: Monotonic deques. For every contiguous window of exactly k readings, produce its maximum from left to right. Produce no values if k exceeds the number of readings. Keep the sequence order specified here before computing the requested receipt. A scan invariant says what has been processed and what remains. Work through the proof strip first, then change the returned summary without changing the definition of that sequence. The last card revisits loop accumulators from Hello, Keys.
constraints: 1 <= k <= 8. All arithmetic results fit a signed 32-bit integer.
Numeric readings lie between -1,000,000 and 1,000,000, subject to the task's shape and ordering rules.

Target time O(n); auxiliary space including the derived sequence O(n). n is the input length; d distinct values; q query count; M maximum reading; V vertices; E edges; h tree height; r reported tree nodes.
hints: Start with monotonic deques. What state describes the portion you have already processed?

For every contiguous window of exactly k readings, produce its maximum from left to right. Produce no values if k exceeds the number of readings. Derive each required reading once; do not restart the whole procedure for every output position.
Return the entire derived sequence, preserving its order. Handle the empty derived sequence according to the stated return rule.
